assets.name: dragonfly-macro-face
assets.prompt: Use case: logo-brand / stylized-concept. Create a new production-quality illustration in INTENT's established dragonfly identity. Input image 1 is the STRICT STYLE reference: match its ivory-white-on-near-black copperplate entomology engraving, very high contrast, fine etched wing veins, stippled and xerox halftone shadows, delicate radiating fine lines, and restrained horizontal glitch slices that break into small square pixel fragments. Input image 2 is the SUBJECT/POSE reference only: reinterpret its perspective in image 1's style; discard all photographic colors and photographic rendering. Background must be flat near-black #0A0B0A. Palette strictly black and ivory white, no green or other colors. Crisp, beautiful anatomical detail; expressive composition but biologically plausible dragonfly anatomy. Controlled digital fragmentation should cut across part of the insect, not obscure its silhouette. No text, letters, numbers, labels, wordmark, watermark, border, UI or collage. Each output is ONE finished illustration, not a contact sheet. Keep clear 8-12 percent margins around the main subject unless a macro crop is explicitly requested. Composition: square macro portrait. Use the second reference's intimate three-quarter frontal close-up: huge beautifully faceted compound eyes, small antennae, finely engraved mouthparts and the upper thorax. The face dominates, angled slightly toward the viewer's right, with a few wing-root veins receding behind it. Dragonfly anatomy, never human eyes or human teeth. Fine white stippled eye facets, dramatic black negative space, a few precise horizontal displacement slices through the cheek and outer eye. Fill 75 percent of frame with a complete readable head and upper thorax. Mood: alert, focused, locked in.
